matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Cascade R-CNN improves the COCO AP of Faster R-CNN by roughly two to four points across multiple backbones with negligible inference overhead.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Cascade R-CNN consistently improves over baseline detectors by 2 to 4 AP points regardless of baseline strength.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Cascade R-CNN trains a sequence of detectors with progressively higher IoU thresholds, where each stage's regressed boxes serve as proposals for the next.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Each bounding box regressor in Cascade R-CNN performs best for input proposals whose IoU is close to the threshold used during training.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: A single-IoU detector trained at a high threshold suffers from too few positive samples, while one trained at a low threshold produces noisy detections that limit final accuracy.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: Training a detector with a high IoU threshold alone degrades detection performance due to exponentially fewer positive training samples.
